tei:div.tei:p: dbus gtsang khri skor gyi dud grangs dang*/ 'ja' mo 'dzin lugs gzhugs so/ /

hor se chen rgyal po'i lung gis/ mi chen das man la bka' stsal pa/ das man khyod nyon gcig bod 'di mi thu mo rang yin par/ sngon bod kyi rgyal po yod pa'i dus/ thang tha'i dzung rgyal po'i ring la/ ri bo rtse lnga'i bar bod dmag mang po yong*/ hu thing hus sar bka' ma log zer ba'i tshan chen po sdod pa byas 'dugad lta bod la rgyal po med/ jing gir rgyal po'i sku bsod la/ /rgyal khams chen po dbang du bsdus/ /sa skya bla ma rang re'i bla mchod du khugs pa 'di yin/ bla ma 'phags pa khu dbon 'di pa/ yul gzhan gyi rgyal po yin na/ khongs shes rab ches pas rang res mi thub/ da lta bod byin rang re'i 'og tu chud pa 'di yin | das sman khyod spyod pa bzang po yod pas/ sa skyar thebs gcig song shig | bod byin po se chen go pe li'i 'og tu chud nas/ mi chen das sman yang sa skya na sleb yod pa 'dug zer ba'i gtam snyan po thob pa yin gsungs/ das sman gyis zhus pa rgyal po khyed kyi lung bzhin 'gro bar byed/ de ltar na'ang bod bya ba mi thu mo yin 'dug pa dang*/ khong rang gi rgyal khrims kyang zhig rgya hor gyi khrims ni ji bzhin ma chags/ so kha rnams kyang ma tshugs par yod 'dug pas | yar phyir gyi mthun rkyen sbyor ba dang*/ bya ba chen po 'grub pa ji ltar yong min zer/ yang rgyal po'i lung gis/ rang re tshang la bod byin po 'og tu chug yod pa 'dug zer ba'i gtam snyan po des chog chas kha cha rkyen gang dgos ma 'thung 'gan pas klagan mdzod pasabluskur/ sa skya man la 'ja' mo che chung du 'os| sa 'jam rtsub/ mi bde dar rgud/ rgya 'jam la 'dapes kladape ltos blul tshugs shog bla ma 'phags pa yar la byon dus 'byon lam bde dgos pa yin/ yang don gcig la/ khyod gson bying dbyen du bskos pa la/ bod kyi gnas lugs rnams zhib par go na/ gnam sa'i bya ba chen po dang*/ mi mang po la phan pa yin pas song shog gsungs nas/

bla ma'i bka' shog dang*/ rgyal po'i 'ja' sa dgos pa rnams gnang*/ das sman 'khor mang po dang bcas pas yar phyir chas/ bod kyi ban skya rgan 'go drag rigs spyi sgos la/ snang sbyin cha rkyen bzang po dang bcas pa/ gan mdzod che chung nas skur te yar yong*/ thog mar bod du bstan pa phyi dar kyi chos byung sa yin pas/ mdo smad kyi dan tig shel gyi lha khang dang*/ mdo stod rtso mdo' bsam 'grub/ gtsang dpal ldan sa skya rnams su rim par mi mang po bsags/ gang la gang 'os kyi gnang sbyin sprad/ bka' lung bsgrags shing rgya bod kyi so mtshams nas/ sa skya man la 'jam chen nyi shu rtsa gsum btsugs/ so sor phye nas mdo smad sa 'jam pas 'ja' mo bdun/ mdo stod la 'ja' mo dgu/ dbus gtsang la 'ja' mo bcu gcig de'i nang nas kyang dbus pas 'ja' mo 'dzin dgos pa la/ sog shag rtsi dbar/ sha pho/ skang | dgon sar/ byam gya ba dang bdun/ gtsang pas 'dzin dgos pa la/stag tshong 'dus/ dar lung*/ grom pa sa skya rang dang bzhi btsugs/ khri skor so sos 'jam skyor 'dab pa'i bkod pa byas/ bod byin po lo rgyal lo yon mchod kyi bka' lung 'phrod/ sa skya 'khor/ bod spyi sgos kyi gnas lugs thams cad khong du chud nas/ rgyal po'i drung du slebs/ rgyu mtshan rnams zhus pas go chod 'dug gsungs/ gsol ras dang*/ gnang sbyin bzang po sbyin/ swon bying dbyen gyis/ khrim rar rtsa ba'i dpon chen du bskos/ bod kyi 'ja' mo rnams gsar btsugs yin pas 'a'ajagasakla'aja' blupar byed pa'i mi gcig bsko dgos pa yod zhus pas/ mi chen i ji lag zer ba la/ bod 'jam shes pa'i 'ja' sa dang*/ thong ji las bka' gnang nas yar la btang*/ de nas bzung | hor sa skya ba yon mchod du ji tsam sbrel kyi bar la/ bod 'jam nyi shu rtsa bdun po de bde mor 'jags pas/ bla ma dpon chen/ hor gyi gser yig pa rnams la/ 'jon lam bde zhing bod 'bangs byin po skyid par byung skad/

'di ni se chen rgyal pos sa skyar gser yig pa sngags pa'i sngon ma yin cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ sa skya ba la shin tu dad pa'i mi dpon bzang po gcig byung 'dug pas/ rnam thar zur tsam bris pa yin/ thong dzi i thi ji lag gis bod 'jam thog tu ma slebs gong hor rgyal po 'jang yul la dmag thog tu byon dus/ mdo smad kyi 'ja' mo gnyis/ rgya 'jams kyi zhor la/ mar la bsdus pas | rim shugs rgyab pas/ mdo stod ga re/ go dpe'i 'ja' mo gnyis dbus gtsang pa la stag skor nas gal/ khrums zhig nas lo shas nan ltar sbyong pa la | thong ji sleb nas/ ga re go sa'i 'ja' mo gnyis po sngar bzhin mdo stod pa rang la khel bas/ thong dzi i ji lag de yang dbus gtsang la drin che bar byung par gda'o/ /hor se chen rgyal po'i dus/ bod khams byin po la mi rtsi dud grangs byung ba'i dus/ mdo smad nas yar rtsis par 'dug pas/ ga chu rab kha nas | nang so la gtogs pa'i gzhis dang*/ gyang gi rtsa dang*/ bla ba 'khar dang*/de'i 'og na dem khang gzhis bya ba yod pas/ de rnams bla ma 'phags pa la/ sa phud du lung gi phul nas/ gan 'jam la sogs dang*/ rgya bod kyi khral dud gang yang mi 'khri ba/ gtsang mar yod pa la/ hor son lnga brgya'i sa yin zer bar 'dug hor dang sa skya ba yon mchod du 'brel nas/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pas/ rgya nag ta'i tu'i pho brang du 'thebs klathengasablugasum byon | gong ma se chen rgyal po yab yum sras bcas la/ sa skya ba'i khyad chos/ rgyud gsum gyi dbang mo che tshar gsum bskur ba'i dbang yon snga ma la/ dbus gtsang gi khri skor bcu gsum phul ba ni/ mnga' ris rdzong kha'i 'og gi blo dol rdzong gsum khri skor gcig la stod lho byang*/ chu zhal rnams re re bgrangs pa khri skor bzhi/ 'bra klasbrabluber khyung gsum khri gcig /yar 'brog tshal pa khri skor gnyis | | rgya 'bri g.ya' phag khri skor bzhi/

/zur nas bsdus pa'i gcig byung ba/ bya yul hor dud stong phrag gcig /'brug pa hor dud dgu brgyar byed/ /stong dang dgu brgya phyed khyer du/ khri skor gcig gi bya ba sgrubs/ /de rnams dril bas phyed khyer tshang*/ /dbang yon bar ma la/ bod chol kha gsum phul ba ni/ mnga' ris gung thang nas/ sog la skya bo yan dam pa chos kyi chol kha/ sog la skya bo nas rma chu khug pa yan/ mgo nag mi'i chol kha/ rma chu khug pa man/ rgya mchod rten dkar po yan/ dud 'gro rta'i chol kha dang gsum yod de/ mi rta chos gsum gyi 'bul ba'i lugs su byas nas/ phul ba yin par 'dug cing*/ chol kha re la dpon chen re re rgyal po yon mchod bka' gros su bstun nas bsko bar mdzad 'dug dbang yon rting ma la bla ma'i bka' bzhin/ rgya'i yur ma chen mo phul nas/ rgyal mi khri khrag mang po srog thar du bcug de dus bla ma 'phags pas sngo ba smon lam 'di ltar mdzad do/ /nam mkha'i khams ni khrag gi mdog ltar dmar/ /rkang leb ro yis phyi yi rgya mtsho gang*/ /'di 'dra bcad pa'i dge ba gang de yis/ /mkhyen rab dbang phyug thugs dgong rdzogs phyir dang*/ /phan sde'i bstan pa rab tu dar phyir dang*/ /mi dbang sku tshe shin tu brtan phyir bsngo/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'gro ba sems can gyi don la phan pa rgya chen po mdzad par gda'o/ /gong ma se chen rgyal po dang*/ bla ma 'phags pa gnyis thugs so bsod 'grel gtam gleng ba'i skabs na/ rgyal pos bla ma la | dang por jing gir rgyal pos rgyal khams byin po bsdus pa'i skabs na/ nged kyi rgyal khams chos pa dang*/ 'jags su 'jug pa'i dus su yang*/ shed mong legs par gdabs pas/ hor kyi dmag mi rnams la/ da lta zas nor gyi stobs zhan pas/ shed mong snon pa'i thabs dang 'chos phyogs ji ltar byas na 'thad gsungs pas/ bla ma'i zhal ta/ khyed rang la yod pa'i mdzod kyi cha rkyen dang*/

dmag mi res pa'i grangs longs la/ lo 'ga'i bar la gzhi 'byas klabacas blukyis lto gos 'tsho ba'i gnang sbyin byed par 'os gsung ba byung nas de bzhin byas pas/ dmag mi la rtsa ba'i hor dmag khri tsho lnga cu dang*/ res pa yang tshan che bar byung ba la/ gnang sbyin byed pa'i cha rkyen ma ldang byung pas/yang rgyal po'i gsungs nas/ da lta cha rkyen gyi ma lcog byung bas/ hor yul gyi lho phyogs na/ sman tshe zhes bya ba'i rgyal po dang*/ de'i 'og na mi sde phyug po yod par 'dug de rang gi smag gis blangs nas/ bu rta'i shed mong bcos na e 'thad gsungs pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ da lta khyed la don chen po 'di sgrub pa'i mi mi snang bas ma ring / nged kyis brtag pa byed gsungs/ de'i phyi lo rgyal po'i gcung po e chen hu la hus/ gong ma la gdab nor lo gsar skyel ba la khong gi mi dpon ba yan zer bas 'go byas/ 'u lag lnga brgya tsam dang bcas pa yong ba'i lam du/ u lug non yon bya ba/ ri dgas la yong / nam la byed pa dang 'phrad | shes rab che ba dang*/ gzugs bzang ba'i mi dpon de gnyis/ rta thog tu dri ba gtam lab byas pas/ gcig la gcig mgu ba yan rgyal po dang mjal 'phrad byas rting*/ rgyal rgyud mi dpon rnams kyi rtsar/ hor yul na/ u lug zer ba'i mi dpon bzang po gcig 'dug de rgyal po'i rtsa ru sdod 'os pa gcig 'dug ces lab pas/ gtam de gong mas gsan nas u lug 'bod mkhan thugs la gtags nas/ nang blon chen por gyur te/ 'dis kyang ba yan la phan gtags pa'i/ gtam rting la yod/ der ba yan rgyal po dang mjal/ pho brang du ston mo chen po byed pa la/ bla ma dam pa gdan drangs pa'i dus na/ ba yan mjal ba'i spyod pa dang 'gro lugs/ zhu ba'i gtam brjod mkhas pa yon tan che bar 'dug pa bla mas mkhyen nas/ rgyal po la mi bzang po kho pa la 'dug gsung*/ rgyal pos dgongs nas ba yan gyi tshab du/ gong ma'i res dpon gcig dang*/

gser yig pa byin po de la/ gnang sbyin bzang po byas/ lo lan bskur nas btang*/ ba yan sdod gsungs nas bsdad yod pa'i skabs su/ khong pa yan dang*/ u lug gnyis gcig las gcig bzang ba'i blon chen gnyis yod pa'i skabs der/ yang rgyal pos bla ma la/ da ba yan 'di sman tshe'i phyogs su btang na gsungs pa la/ de pher ba 'dug nged kyi don 'grub pa'i thabs dang rten 'brel byed gsungs nas/ bal po e ner dga' sprul pa'i lha bzo ba lta bu la zhal ta mdzad/ 'ju tshur lha khang dang*/ chos skyong ma ha ka la 'khor bcas kyi sku bzhengs/ rab gnas bla ma rang gis mdzad/ mgon po'i zhal sman tshe phyogs la gzigs su bcug slob dpon dam pa kun dga' der/ chos skyong sgrub pa mdzad pa la bskos/ ba yan la phying sang gyi ming dam kha byin nas | grogs la rgya'i rigs kyi bya ba'i thang chu'i phing chad zer ba'i mkhas pa gcig kyang btang zhing*/ phying sang gi 'go byas hor dmag byin po brdzangs nas/ sman tshe'i rgyal khams longs la shog gsung ba'i lung byung dus/ ba yan phying sang gis nged sman tsher slebs nas dmag po che'i bya ba 'dra mi 'dra the tshom byung dus/ zhu ba gtong dgos te/ nged kyi gser yig pa gong ma'i drung du 'gro ba dang*/ de sgug pa'i bar du dmag gi 'gro 'dug ji ltar byed zhus pas/ kho bden par 'dug nga'i lung yin gyis la khyod rang gi thag chod la/ bya ba rnams bsgrigs su chug gsungs pa'i lung thob nas phyin pas/ phying sang dmag legs nas | sman tshe rgyal po'i pho brang yang thob nas/ rgyal khams blangs pas/ thad ka thad kar mi dpon gyi bsko bzhag byas/ sman tshe rgyal po'i mu tig gi gos gcig dang dam ga rgyal ba'i rtags byed zer nas phying sang gis bzung*/ gzhan 'phya klachablurkyen byin po rgyal po la gdab tu btang ba'i dus su/ sman tshe'i sa phyogs rgyus yod pa'i skye bo 'ga' res/ mkhar mig gi sa cha mi sde bzang sar las ka zhus/

'ja' sa khyer song bas/ ba yan gyi 'grims du ma bcug cha gcig par nga dang po lung thob yod pa dang*/ mi dpon bskos tshar ba rnams brtan du ma bcug na/ mi sde khrums zhig gis dogs byas nas bya ba 'jags rting | rgyal po'i drung du 'ong nas mjal ba'i tshe/ phying sang res dang 'jal 'phrad grub ma thag kho rang gi khang par ma yong bar/ res khang du bsdad pa'i bar la/ rgyal pos kho la nga rgyal chen po yod dgongs pa gcig byung nas/ zu khu phye gcig ba yan yi rtsar btang nas/ khyod ba yan tshan pa'i ming yin pa gan pa la | sras ming dang las ka chen po byin nas btang ba yin/ sman tshe'i rgyal khams len pa la brtson 'grus bya ba phing chang gis byas/ ming khyod kyis blangs nas nga rgyal ma che gsungs pa zha ི ga bskur nas btang*/ zu gur che song rting*/ rgyal po la the tshom byung nas slog mi btang ba la ma zin/ khos phying sang la/ lung bskyal pas/ phying sang na re/ khyod kyi rgyal po'i lung nged la 'phrod/ nga'i zhu ba rgyal po la e thengs bris pas/ thengs zer ba dang*/ phying sang gis/ nga'i don la rgyal po khyed thugs bde bar mdzod/ 'tshams pa'i mi 'tsham par bzhag na | 'tsham par ka 'gro/ ming dang las ka byin pa ches na rgyal po'i rang dbang yin | sman tshe'i rgyal khams len pa la/ brtson 'grus dang bya ba phing chang gis byas nas ming ba yan gyis blangs gsungs pa ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan sman tshe ba rnams kyi lab ste 'ong*/ rgyal po khyed la don grub pas mi chog gam/ zhus nas btang bas/ gtam de rgyal por zhus pas/ nga'i gtam de mgyogs drags/ khos de zer du byung dogs gsungs lo/ /de rting rgyal pos sman tsher 'ja' sa byin btang ba'i mi/ phying sang gis mi 'grim du ma bcug pa de rnams kyis/ ba yan gyis sman tshe'i rgyal po'i cha rkyen la rang nor byas/ gan mdzod pa la ma gdabs/ 'ja' sa bskos pa'i mi 'grim du ma bcug par/ kho rang gis mi rnams las ka la bskos zer nas/

gtug gsher byung ba la ba yan rang la dris gsungs | ba yan bzung nas phyi rol na bzhag yod pa'i dus su/ u lug no yon gyis go nas nang du byung na/ rgyal po'i drung du 'gro ba phying sang ga ི sa mthong nas/ u lug an ta khyod kyis ma go ba ci yod byas pas/ nga'i go zer nas gong ma la ba yan phying sang*/ mi ngan pas gtug gsher byas/ khong bzung nas gyam bcos 'dugab yan mi gcig rang res bsod kyang sla/ rtsa cig bcod pa dang khyad ci yod de/ sman tshe'i rgyal khams pa rnams kyis rgyal po khyed la | 'phya smod mi yong ngam zhus pas/ de bden kho thong gsungs nas/ las ka phab rang gi khang par bsdad yod pa'i dus re zhig na/ ba yan gyi dmag po che hor yul la 'degs par 'dug zer nas 'ur chen po byung nas/ blon po rnams skrag ste rgyal po la ci drag zhus pas/ khyed rnams gros gyis gsungs pa la/ khong rnams kyi gros byed rgyu ma rnyed par rgya po la bskyar nas zhus pas/ khyed rnams kyis bya thabs ma rnyed pa na/ thabs kyis ba yan la gros dris gsungs nas phyin pas | phying sang na re nga go ma chod par las ka phab nas bsdad pa'i mi'i ci shes/ khyed rang rnams shes mod zer ba byung nas/ de bzhin rgyal po la zhus pas/ gong ma rang gi rtsar ba yan bos nas gros dris pas/ rang re'i hor dmag rnams kyi steng du/ mi bzang po bskos te/ dmag gis 'thab na thub yong mod zhus pas/ ba yan ching sang rang 'gro dgos gsung*/ dmag dpon la bskos nas/ khong 'gro ba'i skyel thung byas par/ ba yan phya

ི nga sang ci zer lta ba'i khad nyan pa la btang*/ ching sang rta zhon 'gro khar sdod pa'i blon po skyel thung pa rnams la/ khyed mi mngags pa la/ 'di 'dra ba'i mi mngags pa zer ba gsum byas nas | song zer ba thos nas rgyal po la zhus pas/ gtam de ma bzang ba yin pas log shog zer ba'i mi btang*/ zim dem 'ja' mor slebs pa phyir bos nas | sang snga mor sleb pa dang*/ rgyal pos ba yan khyod kyi kha sang*/ dze gon mthing nas rta zhon 'gro khar ci lab gsungs pas/ cang ma smras zer/ rgyal po rang gis khyed mi 'di 'dra mngags pa zer lab 'dug pa khyod kyis smras pa min nam gsungs pas/ de ni bden zer/ ci'i don la byas pas/ ching sang gi zhus pa | ngas sman tshe'i rgyal po khyed la rgyal khams gtad pa de/ nyi ma shar nas nub kyi bar la rgyal khams pa rnams kyis shes pa yin/ de'i rting la nga nyes med pa dmangs su phab nas bzhag pa de'ang nyi ma shar nas nub kyi bar du thos yod/'di lta bu'i skyon chen gyi mi gtong pa byang phyogs hor gyi yul na/ rgyal po khyed kyi rgyud pa mi che la mang ba rnams yod/ mi nga skyon phog pa'i mi khong rnams kyi steng du bskos nas btang tsa na/ khong rnams kyang rgyal po khyed la yid chad byed/ dmag po che'i bya ba ci 'dra yong ngam bsams nas lab pa yin zhus pas/ rgyal po na re khyod bden/ ba yan las bden pa med/ da lta rang 'ja' sa bris/ ba yan gyi sman tshe rgyal khams blangs pa dang*/ shed mong ga dbas pa rnams 'ja' sa'i stod du bris/ mi ngan pas rdzun zhus byas pa bar der bris/ ba yan bden pa yin pas ming dang*/ shed mong bsnan pa rnams gting la bris la/ rgyal rgyud bu mo mag pa dmag mi/ mi dpon mi sde rnams kyis/ ba yan gang zer gyis ngag la nyon zer ba'i 'ja' sa sgrog mi sngon la thong la/ de'i rjes la ba yan ching sang 'grim gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas ba yan gyi dmag dpung thul/ hor yul rgyal khams bde bar byas nas tshur 'khor ba dang*/

rgyal pos kyang ba yan la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i thugs 'dogs bzang po mdzad/ rgyal rgyud blon po'i tshogs rnams kyis kyang*/ legs par bkur ba'i blon po rin po che yin par 'dug gal ching gi 'ja' sa la snga ba 'di yin zer ro/ /bla ma 'phags pa la rgyal pos chos zhus pa lta ci smros te/ 'jig rten bya ba chen po rnams kyang bka' gros byed pa'i gtan tshigs gcig 'di yin no/ /bla mas kyang chos dang mthun pa'i 'jig rten gyi bya ba legs pa rnams kyang*/ rgyal po la ston pa yin zer/ sman tshe rgyal pos 'go byas ngo ltas pa rnams yong ba'i dus su/ ji ju'i mgon khang bstan pas/ rang re'i yul du dmag sna la byon pa'i mi nag 'khor bcas de pa yang 'di na 'dug ces zer lo/ /yon 'chod gnyis bka' sgros nas ba yan ching sang sman tsher btang nas rgyal khams blangs pa'i don la 'gro mgon 'phags pas khyed rang lus ma skyod par/ sman tshe'i rgyal rab mang po'i bar du/ khong rang 'jags zin gyi rgyal khams rang res lon pa 'dzam gling gcig tu 'dres 'drar gyur/ khyed rang 'khor los sgyur rgyal dag dang mtshungs/ zhes pa'i bstod pa mdzad pa'ang 'dugamador na 'gro 'gon chos kyi rgyal pos byin brlabs nas/ hor dang rgya nag po'i 'byor ba chen pos | sa skya'i 'go byas bod yul 'dir bstan pa'i mthil yod pa/ yon mchod 'di gnyis kyi bka' drin yin pa gda'/ yi ge'i ngo bo cong zhu zhing gi khrim ra na 'dug pa/ bcwa tshe blang 'dug pa de ngo bshus sbag po ching sang gis dpon chen dbang phyug brtson 'grus la byin nas/ yu gur gyi yi ge ngo bo twa'i dbyen mthong ji deb 'deraklather bluhor gyis ma yig dang lhan gcig du yod pa/ yar lung pas khyer 'dug na'ang*/ don 'di rnams blo la yod pas skabs don bris pa yin yang bsod nams can se chen rgyal po'i dus su/ mi chen sam gha bya ba des/ rus pa 'aka klabaka' blu

ma log yin pa'i mi gzhon gcig hor skad rgya skad yu gur skad bod skad la sogs/ skad rigs sna tshogs shes pa'i lo tstsha ba gcig dang po bla ma 'phags pa'i mdo smad rgya bod kyi mtshams su byon dus mjal nas shed mong gdabs/ ja zhus pas lo tstsha ba la bcug zur khur chen po byed gin yod pa'i dus su/ khong shes rab che/ skad rigs mkhas pa'i don la/ bla ma mnyes nas rgyal po'i drung du yang yang mngags pas | gong mas kyang shes rab dang yon tan la dgongs nas/ bla ma la bslangs/ las ka rim par bskaus pas/ go chod po byung*/ son jing dben gyi mi dpon bskos pa'i dus su/ khong gi me tog ra ba'i bde chen gyi rtsar/ bla ma la chos zhus pa'i sgos kyi 'amatshal klamatshams blukhang gcig byas pa la/ tha'i sas skyon bzung nas/ saṃ gha btson du khyer ba'i dus su/ ka le hu na sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sangs rgyas kyi sku bzhugs pa spyan drangs nas/ 'dzam bu gling 'dir rol mo dang*/ ltad mo yod pa la rgyal po'ang byon nas skor ba dang*/ gzigs mo mdzad pa'i sar/ bla ma gdan 'dren du btang bas/ bla ma'i gsung nas | nged kyi bod yul na bu btson du khyer ba'i pha de/ sprang la 'gro ba la'ang ngo tsha byed/ nga'i sam gha nga la chos zhu ba la dmigs pa'i khang chung gcig byas pa la | tha'i pas skyon du bzung nas btson du khyer 'dug na/ nga mi yong gsungs pas gong ma la zhus pas/ bla ma phebs pa'i gzim khang la dmigs pa yin na kho la skyon ma bzung par thong*/ bla ma la byon gyis gsung pa'i lung byung pas/sam gha nyes pa las grol/ yon mchod zhal mjal/ slar yang son bying dben du bskos pa'i skabs su/ bla ma sa skyar byon/ dpon chen kun dga' bzang pos dam nyams byas pa'i rgyu rkyen gyis/ gong du zhu ba btang bas/ sa skya ba dang sgos su 'brel che bas zhabs tog 'grub par dgong nas/ mi chen sam ghas 'go byas khri dmag stobs che ba 'grim gsungs pa/

lung byung gis sam ghas bod dbus gtsang sa rong dog dmag po che shong sa med/ rtsa ba'i hor dmag khri tsho bdun gyi steng du/ bod stod smad dang bcas pa'i dmag 'bum khrag gcig lhag yong*/ des 'chun pas de bzhin gyi bka' gnang dgos zhus pa/ de ltar yin chug gsungs nas/ khri dmag bteg 'u yug me tog gling du slebs pa dang*/ sa khad yang pas lha shang la dmag lam byed rtsis yod pa/ chab li grong pa slob dpon blo gros bzang pos dmag sgar du ja zhal la byon pas/ dmag lam lang 'gro nang la skyog thub/ hor dmag gi kha 'bebs thum 'jug la/ snga sor lang 'gro mkhar dmar gyi mkhar phab/ babs blangs/ de rting dpal rnams bya rog tshang gi mkhar la gyogs skor rgyag drag po byas nas/ kun dga' bzang po khrims la sgral/ dmag po che'i bya ba mthil phyin pa byas/ bla ma dang dgon pa phra mo la mos pa dang dad gus che ba'i stobs kyis/ sa skyar byon/ 'alcags klalcog bluchung brang khang shar 'di khong gis bzhengs nas/ sgo yig g.yang tshe yang rgya lugs su yod cing bla ma'i drung du cis kyang yong ba'i dgongs pa mdzad par gda'/ de rting khrims dmag byin po phyir ldog spom 'bor sgang nas nyi ma mgon dang*/ dar dges 'go byas dmag rags bsdus brgya drug cu slob dpon dharma pha la'i sku srung la sa skya nye 'khor du bzhag hor dmag stong kha bdun gyi nang nas/ bdun brgya stod hor gyi so kha 'asrun klasrung blupa la bzhagaganam dgon gsar du/ u dmar chag gi 'go byas hor dmag drangs chen bzhi brgya bzhagardor thas 'go byas bha rag gi dmag se ri rong la bzhag u phur gyi dmag lcags tshe 'gru klagri blugu dang*/ yar 'brog tu dung reng gi kha gnon la btang nas bzhag hor ban du man gi dmag gdan sa spyi'i zhabs tog la 'dam/ na dmar/ na rong la sogs byang gi rtsa kha la bzhag pas/ saṃ gha de drin che/ de man la byang gi 'ja' mo sogs/ swāg

shag rtsi dmar/ sha pho/ skong | dgon gsar/ gya ba rnams kyi 'jams chen/ bod dbus gtsang gi khri skor rnams kyis 'dzin mkhan klalo blukhor mar gtong dgos pas/ bka' tshegs sbyong spyod shin du che ba gcig yod pa 'dug cing*/ bod dmag rnams kyis byang ma thub par bros nas/ 'jam brang so ma zin pas/ hor bod kyi gser yig 'grul pa la sa rim gyi o ge kha'i 'u lag rang rang la babs pa'i don la thams cad kyis zhus pa bzhin/ mi chen sa ghas phur dang sba rag la sogs pa'i dmag mi/ byang khar yod pa rnams 'ja' mo'i za 'khri 'then pa la/ tha dad du bzhag nas/ dbus pa khri skor rnams kyi/ dud rta mgo'i steng nas rta khal pa/ bzhon ma/ bshas lug 'jams rgyags kyi nas/ cha ther sbra/ sga gdan/ khal g.yag thab chas/ gdan chas/ sman rin/ dud mi dang bcas pa hor la ster ba'i khrims bcas nas/ dbus pa byang du sdod mi dgos pa/ hor dmag rnams la bod rdzas kyi 'jams skyor 'di rnams lo lo bzhin yong ba 'grul ba rnams la 'ja' mo/ /'u lag rnams ma stongs pa byung nas/ kun la phan pa 'di yang sam gha'i drin/ khong gis bod 'khor nas/ bcong zhu zhing gi ching sang la bskos pa'i dus su/ sngar 'khar ba'i dor tshe 'grim pa cha 'or gyur pas/ 'ganaklagan mdzod blupa'i zhabs tog dang*/ rgyal khams la phan par byung bas/ gtam snyan thob/ dang po mi dpon rnams kyi sus za med klapa za blupa'i don la nyes pa phog pa'i mi dpon mang po byung*/ khrims kyang yang por song pa/ sam gha ching sang gis sngon rgya nag po'i dus kyi srol rnying pa gcig btsal nas/ khrims ra che chung gi mi dpon rnams la/ bza' rgyu dang*/ gon rgyu'i hun brtsan/ bud med la sogs pa la yang*/ za 'bras smar po dang bcas pa byin nas/ sus pa mi za ba'i khrims su bcas pas/ khrims dam por song*/ mi sde'ang skyid/ da lta'i bar la mi dpon rnams la hun tsan 'jags pa yang*/ saṃ gha'i drin dran par byed/

gzhan yang bstan pa dang bod la phan pa dang*/ 'bul ba gtong ba la sogs pa'ang khong gi bla ma'i zhabs tog la dmigs nas zhus pas/ phan pa mang po byung gda'o/ /yang don gcig la sam gha phyi saṃ shes rab che/ longs spyod dang ldan pas hor mang po'i mig tu ma shong bar/ khong gi gan pa shas cha rkyen ma phangs byas pas res pa she mong la bsnan zer ba'i don la phying sang gis/ gzhan ma'i cha rkyen sus mar zas zer ba la snyad byas nas/ gong ma phyi lam du dos pa rnams kyis zhus/ gtug gsher byas pas lung gis res pas ji ltar byed 'chos nged shes mod/ saṃ dga' la don ci yod/ sus pa byas na gzhan gyi gtug mod/ kho la cha rkyen 'dug zer nas nyes pa 'tshal ga nas nyan gsungs nas zhu ba ma bzhes kyang*/ dos dpon rnams kyis res pa rnams skul nas | skyar gin zhus pas de gong nas snon thabs dzad/ saṃ dga' la u lug dang*/ khyed gnyis 'khrod par gyis gsungs byung nas/ saṃ ghas u lug gung gral la bzhag ston mo bzang po byin nas saṃ gha rang gi zha gos skye rags phul/ an ta byed byas pas/ zhwa gos skye rags khyer na mi 'dod/ ston mo gong ma'i gsol ras yin pas zos yod/ zer nas/ bzhud skad/ rting du yang res pa rnams kyis res dpon rnams dang*/ u lug no yon skul nas/ saṃ gha la sngar bzhin skyon bzung nas zhus pa'i mthar/ kho'i cha rkyen la bsnyad nas nyes pa len gar nyan/ rgyal khams kyi cha rkyen rnams nga rang gi yin/ de yin na nga rang gis dri ba byed gsungs nas/ saṃ gha la sngar gtsigs che/ phang byed pa'i dus su/ rgyal po rang gi mkhyen pas/ nyes pa bsangs zin rnams phyis rtol ba la/ sam gha khyod shang mdo nas/ ta'i tur mngags dus 'ur sdo 'grims pa'i lam du/ shing sdong po'i rtsa bar nged bsil grib la sdod pa'i khri thog tu khyod kyis bsdad pa dang*/ ta'i tu nas nged la skur ba'i se thog gi sgam/ hung la bshig nas zas phud khyod kyis zas pa'i nyes pa med dam/

yang nged lus rngul che bas gos dri ma can bkrus te/ skyar nas btsem dus/ dog mor 'gro yin 'dug pas/ de'i don la/ rgya'i 'thag mkhan gyis gos srubs med pa thags pa ston pa gnyis yod pa khyod la gsum 'dug zer/ nga las lhag pa byed pa khyod kyi nyes pa min nam gsungs te | dṛ ba gsum po mdzad rting la/ ding sang rgyal khams kyi bya ba pher ba'i mi ji 'dra yod gsungs pas/ mi gcig gda'/ gzhan mi gda' zhus pa dang*/ gcig yod pa su yin gsungs/ phying sang kho rang gi sna la 'dzub mo btsugs byung | de pho nya la skul nas btang bas/ rjes na phar phying sang ci zer lta mi btang bas/ khong sgrol ba'i sar sleb rtsa na khyed rnams kyis/ mtshon rno ba dang*/ lag yang ba dang myur ba'i thabs kyis byas yod 'dug pa la/ sgrol mkhan gyis khyod kyis bzlas pa'i khar mi 'gro/ ji ltar byed nged shes pa yin mod zer zhus pas | rgyal po na re/ nga'i saṃ gha 'gro khar sems sdug tu bcug 'dug mi ngan de rnams la rgyug pa brgya dang bdun re rgyob gsungs pa'i lung byung zer/ dus de rtsa na bla ma 'phags pa bzhugs na/ thugs rje la bstan nas tshe thar 'gro zer gleng bar gda'/ 'di 'das kyang phyag rjes can gyi blon po bzang por 'dug pas gnas lugs bris pa yin no// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed/dbus gtsang khri skor gyi dud grangs dang*/ 'jal mo 'dzin lugs kyi skor/ -PAGE 146--PAGE 147-
